title: The “cheat” needs device admin
scenario: A friend shares a cheat or mod that supposedly unlocks premium features. The installer asks you to disable security warnings and give it device-admin or accessibility permissions.

answers.A: Ask a trusted adult or technically knowledgeable person to explain what the requested permissions can do.
answers.B: Install it on a spare device first to see whether it works safely.
answers.C: Do not install it; remove the file and use only trusted app/game sources.

explanation: Admin/accessibility permissions can let malicious apps read screens, intercept codes or control settings. A spare device can still expose accounts.
proTip: A cheat that needs security disabled is telling you what it is.
